package.description: Screen capture tool that won't upload anything anywhere.

en-US.description: Screen capture tool that won't upload anything anywhere.
en-US.longDescription:
ShareNot is a customized version of ShareX, specifically designed for corporate use to prevent data leakage. With ShareNot, you can safely capture screenshots and screen recordings without any risk of uploading data to external servers.
ShareNot is ideal for organizations that need to maintain strict control over their data, ensuring that all captured information remains within the company's secure environment.
en-US.name: ShareNot

zh-CN.description: 不上传任何内容的屏幕截图工具。
zh-CN.longDescription:
ShareNot 是 ShareX 的定制版本，专为企业使用而设计，以防止数据泄露。通过 ShareNot，您可以安全地捕获屏幕截图和屏幕录制，而无需担心数据被上传到外部服务器。
ShareNot 非常适合需要严格控制数据的组织，确保所有捕获的信息都保留在公司安全的环境中。
